-96.79810,46.83040.name: Sanford Health Reproductive Medicine Institute
-96.79810,46.83040.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Christina Broadwell, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

-96.72936,43.54760.name: Sioux Falls VA Health Care System
-96.72936,43.54760.desc: An organisation accredited by AAALAC International for its care and use of laboratory animals. Part of Department of Veterans Affairs. Accreditation is voluntary and paid for, so this is a list of organisations that chose to be inspected rather than a register of everyone doing the work. An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. The directory gives a city and country and no street address, so this point marks where the organisation is registered rather than the building where animals are held.

-71.27400,42.52500.name: Parexel
-71.27400,42.52500.desc: A large contract research organisation, taken private by investment funds, which runs clinical trials and through a substantial regulatory consulting arm writes and files the submissions that go to the FDA and EMA. The same firm can design the study, run it and argue for it, and none of that appears on the approval, which carries the sponsor's name.

77.21000,28.56800.name: Federation of Seed Industry of India
77.21000,28.56800.desc: The Indian seed industry association, which has argued for trait fee levels against state governments that capped them. Indian states have set Bt cotton seed prices by law, which is one of the few places a government has directly controlled what a trait may be sold for.

54.37700,24.45300.name: Emirati Genome Programme
54.37700,24.45300.desc: Sequencing the entire Emirati population, with the data held by the state and used in preventive health and in newborn screening. Sovereign genomic programmes of this kind are being built across the Gulf, and they answer the ownership question by not asking it: the state holds everything.
